source: Wowhead TBC guides - note: Subtlety is primarily a PvP spec in TBC; rarely optimal in raids
summary: Hemorrhage as the primary combo builder (applies a stacking physical damage debuff). Keep Slice and Dice up, Rupture for bleed, Eviscerate as dump. Shadowstep for gap closing. Primarily valued in raids for the Hemorrhage armor debuff.

Sinister Strike.note: Combat combo builder - a Subtlety build should use Hemorrhage as its primary combo point generator

Mutilate.note: Assassination ability - wrong spec for a Subtlety rogue

breakpoint.note: Hemorrhage applies a stacking physical damage taken debuff - the main reason to bring Subtlety to a raid. If no other rogues or warriors are maintaining this debuff, it provides real value. In a full melee group it may be redundant.

advisory: Subtlety is rarely brought to SSC/TK raids for DPS - it underperforms Combat and Assassination on sustained single-target. Its primary raid value is the Hemorrhage debuff (+3 stacks of increased physical damage taken) and utility. If you see a Subtlety rogue in the log, confirm the Hemorrhage debuff is being maintained and the spec choice is intentional. Fight notes: Hemorrhage uptime is what justifies the spec - on heavy-melee fights (Gruul, Hydross, single-target bosses) make sure the debuff stays at full stacks so the rest of the melee group benefits. With Premeditation + Shadowstep you can re-open instantly after forced movement (Vashj striders, Kael phase transitions), so prioritize staying on the boss to keep Slice and Dice and Rupture rolling.
